div.div: ضَبِيحٌ An arrow altered in colour [by fire]; as also ↓ مَضْبُوحٌ . (TA. [See an ex. of the latter in a verse of Tarafeh cited voce مُجْمِدٌ: and see also what here next precedes.]) It is also applied, (S, O,) in the same sense, (O,) to roasted flesh-meat. (S, O.) [And Freytag explains it as meaning, in the Deewan of Jereer, “ Cutis nigra, usta vulneribus. ”]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
